title: GaitSettings
description: Data file content/behaviour/gaits.json (Marcel F5264 = A): how far an inhabitant walks per tick and which gait the core uses for a walk. One tick is one game minute, about 0.83 s real time at normal speed, so the metres per tick are also the speed the eye sees. The core reports the gait id in the inhabitant snapshot; the presentation plays the animation gait of the same id. The gait follows from data only, first match wins: pressing_need_gait if the walk's action serves a need below its neglect_below, then action_gaits, then default_gait. Factors are placeholders: look first, then tune.

walk_m_per_tick.description: Metres per tick of a factor-1 gait on flat meadow (shallow water and slopes slow it by the map's speed factor).

gaits.description: The gaits the core knows; ids match the gaits of content/animation/library.json.

default_gait.description: Gait of every walk that no other rule names.

action_gaits.description: Gait per action (action vocabulary), each action at most once.

spacing.description: Personal space between inhabitants (Marcel W1687, W1688/B2569, W1691). Missing: no spacing (inhabitants may stand in one spot). Only spacing, no new behaviour (B2460).

pressing_need_gait.description: Gait of a walk whose action serves a need (the need of the action's first consideration in content/behaviour/utility.json) that is below the need's neglect_below in content/inhabitants/model.json. null = no such rule.

factor_of_walk.description: Speed as a multiple of walk_m_per_tick (placeholder).

conversation_min_m.description: An action aimed at another inhabitant (show, warn, teach ...) starts no closer than this to the listener: the actor steps back on the line to the listener if needed (placeholder).

conversation_max_m.description: Such an action starts once the actor is this close to the listener (replaces the action's reach_m for inhabitant targets; at least conversation_min_m, checked at load).

min_separation_m.description: No inhabitant ends a move closer than this to another: a walker that would is put on the nearest free spot beside the other (deterministic, no random draw). At most conversation_min_m, checked at load.

yield_lookahead_m.description: A walker yields when another inhabitant is ahead within this distance and closer than min_separation_m to its line (B2569).

yield_offset_m.description: How far a yielding walker steps to its RIGHT (relative to its walking direction) per tick, in addition to its step (B2569).

facing_tolerance_deg.description: During such an action actor and listener turn their whole body to each other (B2528); this is the largest angle between facing and the direction to the other that counts as facing (presentation and tests).

listener_turns_during.description: One action owns legs and body (TL #20001): the actor of such an action stops and turns to the listener; the listener turns its body to the actor only when it has no action of its own or one of these (action vocabulary) and is not walking. Otherwise its own action keeps the body.
